exceptions.reason: AppKit Genie 0.76.1 orchestrates the conversation through sendMessage. A request-scoped client retains single POST, abortable HTTP, bounded read retries, safe errors and exact result types; upstream omits signals on those calls and logs raw SDK errors. Attachments without statement IDs retain their read path.
exceptions.removeWhen: Programmatic Genie with its default client proves mandatory OBO, cancellation on every call, no submission replay, safe logs, bounded reads, all attachments and the 500-row contract. Replace the compatibility client only after these tests pass.

exceptions.reason: Private personal-state writes, null bindings, native scalar types, explicit driver transport and standalone CLI diagnostics retain @databricks/sql. AppKit leaves JSON_ARRAY scalar values as strings and parses JSON-looking STRING cells.
exceptions.removeWhen: AppKit preserves bound nulls, native scalar types, exact STRING values, private write semantics and diagnostic authentication.

exceptions.reason: AppKit resolves workspace identity even with only its server plugin. Demo injects a fail-closed client with two synthetic metadata responses.
exceptions.removeWhen: Upstream server-only startup supports offline mode without identity resolution.

exceptions.reason: 0.76.1 ignores profile when host is also passed. Local OAuth uses the existing named CLI token provider for each operation.
exceptions.removeWhen: Upstream supports named CLI U2M credentials, host verification and token refresh together.

exceptions.reason: Statement Execution can return result {} after a successful zero-row JSON_ARRAY query. The client supplies data_array [] only when the non-truncated manifest proves zero rows and zero chunks with a column schema. Unknown or incomplete results remain errors; no resubmission occurs.
exceptions.removeWhen: AppKit returns data [] for an empty result proven by the statement manifest, while still rejecting incomplete and truncated responses.
